# Nehemiah 11 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Nehemiah 11 (36 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 2

---

## V.1 — "holy city" — all translators agree
- **EMET/LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "holy city" / "the holy city"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the holy city" — All agree; the designation is theologically significant and preserved as a title.

---

## V.11 — "ruler" vs. "chief officer"
- **EMET:** "ruler" (*nagid*) / **LOGOS:** "ruler" / **PNEUMA:** "chief officer"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "chief officer" — In the temple context, "chief officer" is more precise than "ruler," which could imply political authority beyond the temple administration.

---

*— SOPHIA*
